db_assertions.db_subject: The Critical Role of Tryptophan in the Antimicrobial Activity and Cell Toxicity of the Duck Antimicrobial Peptide DCATH.
db_assertions.db_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (80%) to dCATH I=L=A=K=R: 13%. Activity: active against E. coli ATCC 25922 or UB1005 (MIC 2-4 uM), S. pullorum C79-13 (MIC 4 uM), S. typhimurium ATCC 14028 (MIC 4 uM), S. aureus ATCC 29213 (MIC 8 uM), S. epidermidis ATCC 12228 (MIC 8 uM), and E. faecalis ATCC 29212 (MIC 8 uM). In vitro toxicity: human RBC, ~10% hemo.lytic at 128 uM. Antimicrobial robustness: NaCl-insensitive:E. coli ATCC25922 (150 mM); KCl-insensitive:E. coli ATCC25922 (4.5 mM); NH4Cl-insensitive:E. coli ATCC25922 (6 uM); MgCl2-insensitive:E. coli ATCC25922
